name: keydris-reader-node
description: Node workspaces: the @keydris/kit-reader library and a sample MCP server built on it

scripts.build: npm run build -w @keydris/kit-reader && npm run build -w @keydris/kit-reader-github-demo
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @keydris/kit-reader && npm run dev -w @keydris/kit-reader-github-demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @keydris/kit-reader && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
